changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE cart DROP CONSTRAINT ck_cart_checkout_lifecycle_value

ALTER TABLE cart ADD CONSTRAINT ck_cart_checkout_lifecycle_value CHECK (checkout_lifecycle_state IS NULL OR checkout_lifecycle_state IN ('INCOMPLETE', 'REQUIRES_ESCALATION', 'READY_FOR_COMPLETE', 'PROCESSING', 'COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED', 'MERCHANT_HANDOFF_REQUIRED', 'RECOVERABLE_FAILURE', 'TERMINAL_FAILURE', 'UNKNOWN'))
